searchText: Then what is beacon block? A beacon block is a block on the beacon (consensus) chain. Thank you! Is it only me or spam in this server has increased considerably? It's becoming much harder to follow conversations when every channel appears updated all the time. This is a feature that Discord could add: when removing messages from a banned user, restore the notification status of the channel to the previous state before those messages discord spam bots have increased considerably. Likely catchpa is needed for this discord. Consensys has a decent system for their discord. In <#844188570101350470> <@397389662085185547> gave a good feedback regarding automatic banning of someone repeating the same message `N` times. I think `N` can be as low as 3 Setting up a discord captcha bot is a matter of ~15min and should solve the bot problems. The captcha is based on text recognition: https://top.gg/bot/512333785338216465
